cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll rebuild the wedding bookings. Could you reassure the couples?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Keep that screen here. Give them the replacement dates; I'll handle the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can restore everything, but they'll get an email naming whoever cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's helpful. Restore the dates individually instead; I'll stay and read them out.
